_comment: Flags: small badges for a characteristic of a unit or region (ui/common/flag.gd). role is a color role from data/ui/ui_kit.json color_roles; icon an id from icons.json. Screens may also make a flag on the fly with Flag.make().

boss.label: Boss
boss.text: The act's boss. Losing to it ends the run.

elite.label: Elite
elite.text: A stronger enemy than its kind.

low_hp.label: Low HP
low_hp.text: Below a third of its HP.

fortified.label: Fortified
fortified.text: Left alone too long: its defense rose.

under_attack.label: Under attack
under_attack.text: A neighbor's attack is building here. Reinforce it or face a defense fight.

uprising.label: Uprising
uprising.text: Unrest is building inside it. Reinforce it or lose it.

yours.label: Yours
yours.text: You hold it: it pays out every day.

in_range.label: In range
in_range.text: Hostile and next to your network: you can attack it.

out_of_reach.label: Out of reach
out_of_reach.text: Hostile, but not next to your network. Take a neighbor first.
